about: Groups one part of a page under its own heading, with the controls that act on that part. The section is a landmark named by its title.

annotated.about: The header above the body, and the header in a column beside it, as a settings page lays out. A section narrower than the `sm` breakpoint puts the header back above the body.
annotated.title: Annotated

cards: Cards this account can be charged on.

folding.about: The same section in a narrow and a wide room. In the narrow one, the secondary action shows its icon alone, the tertiary action moves behind the folded control, and the primary action keeps its text.
folding.title: Folding

next: The next invoice is due on 1 October.
profileAbout: The name and the email address on the account.

size.about: The three sizes. The size sets the title and the description one size smaller, the gaps between the bands and the card's inner room. The buttons take the same size through their provider.
size.title: Sizes

title: Section
usage: Twelve of twenty seats are in use.

variant.about: Both looks: plain on the page, and raised as a card. A plain section that follows another has a hairline above it.
variant.title: Looks
